source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.4「目視外飛行」(1)2)補助者を配置しない場合

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 補助者なしBVLOSでは有人航空機側からの視認性を高める対策も追加要件として考慮する。
evidence.tested_misconception: BVLOSでは操縦者画面だけ見えれば、航空機側からの機体視認性は不要である。
evidence.reasoning_path: no-assistant BVLOS -> reduced external observation -> conspicuity requirement -> lighting/paint mitigation

collision.note: LOW。night-lightingの機体向き視認とは目的が異なり、有人航空機からのconspicuityを問う。

independent_review.rationale: 6.4 no-assistant BVLOS supports conspicuity by lights/recognizable paint; purpose is distinct from Q100 operator night visibility.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent reviewer evidence is source-consistent and correctly distinguishes integration/decision-boundary variants from exact semantic collisions. The 23 accepted candidates retain distinct propositions and commercial practice value; the two collision candidates must not receive acceptance packets or Permanent IDs.
